description: Turns a Unix timestamp (seconds, ms, µs or ns, detected by length) or a wall-clock date and time in a zone into the instant in UTC, the time in other IANA zones (with daylight saving) and every timestamp unit. With nothing given it uses now.

date.description: Wall time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss]" in `zone`, instead of a timestamp

zones.description: Zones to show the instant in (default UTC and this machine’s zone)

name: timestamp_convert
title: Unix timestamps and time zones
